# Legacy SQLite fixture

[简体中文](README.md)

`core.js` and `spec.js` are unchanged copies from the MIT-licensed `@chatecnu-work/dsh-memory-native@0.1.0-alpha.5`, used to generate synthetic legacy data through the official SQLite storage backend.

The fixture contains no real user data, configuration or credentials.
